Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 12

“Desiring the fruition of their actions, people here worship the gods; for in the human world success born of action comes quickly.”

Krishna explains the appeal of transactional worship without contempt. It is popular because it works, and works fast — an honest account of what it gives, and what it does not.
